pending_interview.category: System design (ML/AI-specific) — RAG at scale, eval pipeline design, recommendation systems, agent platforms, feature store design
pending_interview.question: You are asked to design a recommendation system for a large e-commerce platform that serves personalized product rankings to hundreds of millions of users. The system must return results in under 100 milliseconds at the point a user loads their homepage. Walk through the full architecture: how you generate candidate items to consider, how you rank them, where machine learning fits in versus simpler rules, how you keep recommendations fresh as user behavior changes, and how you store and serve the features (pieces of user and item data) the model needs at serving time. What are the main failure modes, and how would you design the system to degrade gracefully rather than break completely when individual components go down?
